html:
A state founded about 1712 by Biton Coulibaly at Segou on the Niger, which became the main power of the middle Niger in the 18th century.

Biton turned a young men's association into a standing army of captives and volunteers. The Bamana kings kept their own religion while employing Muslim traders and clerics, and they took Djenne and Timbuktu at times. Their wealth came from raiding and the trade in captives. Mungo Park reached Segou in 1796. In 1861 the jihad of Umar Tall conquered it. Bamana, or Bambara, is now the most widely spoken language of Mali. See also Segu.
sum: A state founded about 1712 by Biton Coulibaly at Segou on the Niger, which became the main power of the middle Niger in the 18th century.
